name: Lead Volley (Combat, Teamwork)
body:
When you mark a target with a ranged attack, you aid your allies aim.

Prerequisite(s): Weapon Focus (any ranged weapon)

Benefit(s): You may make a single attack at your highest base attack bonus as a standard action to grant each ally who makes a ranged attack against the target to gain a +1 circumstance bonus on their first ranged attack against the target before your next turn.

Special: If you and an adjacent ally both have this feat and attack the same target the circumstance bonus becomes +2 for each ally attacking thereafter.
